code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia, with low oxygen saturation and pH, suggestive of significant respiratory compromise. There is leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), indicating possible severe infection or inflammation. Coagulation is impaired (INR elevated). Liver and renal function are preserved. Findings are consistent with severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis with respiratory failure; urgent clinical correlation and intervention are recommended.
